name: Adriel
source:
Adriel is a cheerful person, always ready to drop a joke or a compliment to those around him. At work, he is even more frequently seen chattering rather than actually working, and some would even find him annoying. And if he appears confident, there is nothing Adriel fears more than bothering others... let's hope Doug appreciates his antics.

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/rendez-doug]official profile[/url]]
